desc: 暖白软紫育婴房地垫系，讲透腰贴、弹力腰围与双层腿根的纸尿裤套图
name: 宝宝腰贴纸尿裤柔护款

shots.intent: 首屏一眼把本品讲清楚是腰贴式而不是拉拉裤：展开单片立在育婴房地垫上，腰围与两片腰贴同时可见。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 46pt in #4A4E7C with a lighter sub-line 「{callout_1}」 at 16pt beneath; the two butter-yellow pill capsules carry 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 at 13pt; a hairline keyline #F2D488 traces the product silhouette

shots.intent: 把腰贴式尿裤最容易被劝退的四个日常瞬间摆到第二屏，让买家先点头再听卖点。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_2}」 at 38pt in #4A4E7C with one butter-yellow #F2D488 outlined capsule 「{callout_4}」 at 14pt beneath; four small hairline circle markers #AEB8E8 numbered by glyph only, each with a short caption 「{callout_5}」 at 12pt under its tile; the copy never states a result, a duration or a number

shots.intent: 同机位同光双格，只比可见构造：宽腰围与两片大腰贴的形状和贴合状态，一眼看出差别在哪。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_3}」 at 34pt in #4A4E7C in the top band; one butter-yellow #F2D488 capsule under each panel, left 「{callout_6}」 and right 「{callout_7}」 at 13pt; two hairline leader labels 「{callout_8}」 at 12pt pointing at the belt edge and the tape wing; no badges, no arrows implying data, no numerals

shots.intent: 把腰围那一圈橡筋和贴合面做成看得见的做工证据，替掉一切口播式承诺。
shots.textZone: top strip carries the headline 「{selling_point_4}」 at 30pt in #4A4E7C plus one butter-yellow capsule label 「{callout_9}」 at 13pt tied to the elastic band by a hairline leader; a second hairline label 「{callout_10}」 marks the belt-to-body seam

shots.intent: 低后侧角同时拍到立体防漏边与内表层的小印花和压点，把结构一次交代清楚。
shots.textZone: right margin carries the headline 「{selling_point_5}」 at 30pt in #4A4E7C stacked over two butter-yellow #F2D488 capsule labels 「{callout_11}」 and 「{callout_12}」 at 13pt, each tied by a hairline leader to the cuff and to the printed layer

shots.intent: 俯拍三步只教备料与展开手法，不拍换洗动作，把用法讲明白同时守住婴儿出镜底线。
shots.textZone: three hairline circle markers #AEB8E8 step down the left margin, each with a short label 「{callout_13}」 at 13pt in #4A4E7C; one caption line at the bottom reads 「{callout_14}」 at 16pt; one butter-yellow capsule at the top reads 「{callout_15}」 at 13pt

shots.intent: 用大人怀抱的背影给一张真实尺度参照，同时把本品放回育婴房场景里。
shots.textZone: upper-left clean zone carries one short line 「{callout_16}」 at 15pt in #4A4E7C inside a hairline-outlined butter-yellow #F2D488 capsule; no headline and no body text

shots.intent: 俯视把展开、对折贴合、卷起收拢三种形态同框摆清，选款和收纳疑问一次解决。
shots.textZone: the lower chalk card #FFFFFF carries three short option labels 「{callout_17}」 at 14pt in #4A4E7C beside hairline leaders, and one butter-yellow capsule 「{callout_18}」 at 13pt; values are placeholders, never numbers

shots.intent: 用一张规整核对卡收口下单前疑问，字段全部留白占位，绝不写任何未经核实的参数与声明。
shots.textZone: periwinkle header bar carries white type 「{selling_point_6}」 at 30pt with a hairline sub-line 「{callout_19}」 at 13pt and three pagination dots; the card carries a large title placeholder 「{callout_20}」 at 26pt in #4A4E7C, four label rows reading 「{callout_21}」 at 13pt with hairline rules, and one butter-yellow capsule 「{callout_22}」 at 13pt

shots.intent: 以一句收口主张加一颗行动胶囊结束详情页，把前九屏的构造印象收进加购动作。
shots.textZone: lower periwinkle band carries the CTA pill 「{callout_23}」 at 18pt in #4A4E7C type plus one supporting line 「{callout_24}」 at 13pt in chalk-white type; the upper-right clean zone carries a short line 「{selling_point_1}」 at 22pt in #4A4E7C; no QR code, no price, no membership wording

style.backgroundSystem: a calm nursery floor: a chalk-white wall #F7F3EA meets a quilted play mat #EFEAE0 with visible stitched square channels and hairline seams #E2DACB, one low rounded periwinkle riser #AEB8E8 used instead of hard blocks, and rounded-corner copy cards #FFFFFF outlined in #AEB8E8; a single hairline seam rule #AEB8E8 marks section breaks; depth stays shallow and domestic; never an arch panel, never a stacked plinth, never a wave band, never an outdoor scene, no gradients outside the chalk field
style.direction: soft nursery chalk-and-periwinkle ecommerce, quiet high-key care commerce for taped baby diapers
style.iconSystem: small butter-yellow #F2D488 pill capsules closed with a hairline #4A4E7C outline, each carrying one short dark label or one single-weight line pictogram; thin hairline circle markers in #AEB8E8 for sequences; hairline leader lines only; flat and quiet, one weight throughout; no aqua arches, no solid tiles, no filled colour icons, no 3D icons, no hazard stripes, no amber dots, no cartoon illustration
style.lightingSystem: diffuse frontal wrap light at about 5200K, near-shadowless and even across the whole set, one faint soft contact shade only at the line where the product touches the mat, no cast shadow, no rim flash, no directional drama, no dark falloff; the same 5200K logic holds inside the lifestyle frames so the set never splits into two lighting worlds
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft nursery chalk-and-periwinkle ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm chalk white #F7F3EA, card white #FFFFFF, soft periwinkle #AEB8E8, deep ink periwinkle #4A4E7C for headline type, quilted mat beige #EFEAE0 with stitched seams #E2DACB and one butter-yellow accent #F2D488, with any product-derived accent supplied as {accent_color}; neutral temperature throughout; one soft humanist Chinese sans display family for headlines plus one light geometric sans for body and labels, headline type in #4A4E7C on chalk white and chalk-white type on periwinkle, identical hierarchy and corner radii on every screen; background is a calm nursery floor where a chalk-white wall #F7F3EA meets a quilted play mat #EFEAE0 with visible stitched square channels, one low rounded periwinkle riser #AEB8E8 as the only stage element and a hairline seam rule #AEB8E8 at section breaks, never an arch panel, never stacked plinths, never a wave band; diffuse frontal wrap light at about 5200K, near-shadowless, with one faint soft contact shade only at the touch line, no cast shadow and no rim flash; layout uses small butter-yellow #F2D488 pill capsules closed by a hairline #4A4E7C outline and carrying short dark labels, rounded-corner cards #FFFFFF outlined in #AEB8E8, thin hairline circle markers and hairline leader lines, plus one hairline keyline #F2D488 tracing the product silhouette as a graphic device; the taped diaper keeps its identity on every screen, hourglass body, wide flat elastic waist belt, two side tape wings with a dotted fastening face, frilled dual leg cuffs, small printed repeat on the inner acquisition layer, proportions and colourway never re-tinted, the outer back sheet rendered as a soft matte film with the faintest sheen and the inner touch layer rendered as a cloth-like matte fibrous nap and never alike, nothing floating without its contact shade; any baby is anonymous, back turned or cropped above the jaw and always held by an adult, and no fastening action on a baby is ever shown; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no aqua arch, no hazard stripe, no amber dot, no invented claim or figure.
noDrift: no colour palette changes
no mixed fonts
no random backgrounds
no inconsistent lighting
no mismatched icon styles
no arch panel, no stacked plinth blocks and no wave band, which belong to another suite
no aqua or lake-blue accent, no hazard stripes and no amber dots
no gradient outside the chalk field
no altered waistband form, tape shape, cuff shape, printed repeat, side panel or colourway
no re-tinted product and no redesigned print layout on the product
no outer film rendered like the cloth-touch inner layer, and no plastic gloss or paper look on either
no absorbency volume or millilitre figure
no dry-hours, wear-time or night-length figure
no breathability percentage or airflow test value
no material composition, fibre name, cotton share or content percentage
no skin-health, rash, allergy or medical prevention claim and no soothing or healing wording
no additive-free, bleach-free, non-toxic or harmless-substance wording
no age range, month range or weight range
no pack count, piece count, dimension, weight or size value
no certification, test report, lab number, patent or standard code
no identifiable baby face, no nappy-change in progress and no baby lying unattended
no liquid, wet patch, staining or run-off anywhere in the set
no price, discount, coupon, membership badge, QR code, watermark or added brand wordmark
style.presentationRules: the taped diaper is the only hero and keeps its identity on every screen: hourglass body, wide flat elastic waist belt, two side tape wings with a dotted fastening face, frilled dual leg cuffs, small printed repeat on the inner acquisition layer, proportions and colourway never re-tinted and never restyled; shown open, half-folded, rolled or in macro, always with a real contact shade on the mat and never floating; a single hairline keyline #F2D488 may trace the silhouette as a graphic device but never reads as a product part; the outer film side and the cloth-touch inner side are always rendered as two different materials; any baby is anonymous, back turned or cropped above the jaw, and always held by an adult, and no fastening action on a baby is ever shown
style.surfaceSystem: quilted nursery mat #EFEAE0 with stitched channels in #E2DACB and a low periwinkle riser #AEB8E8 as the only stage element; matte card white #FFFFFF for copy fields; the product itself keeps its own finishes, the outer back sheet reading as a soft matte film with the faintest sheen and the inner touch surface reading as a cloth-like matte fibrous nap, the two never rendered alike and never as plastic gloss or as paper
style.typography: one soft humanist Chinese sans display family for headlines plus one light geometric sans for body and labels; headline type in #4A4E7C on chalk white and chalk-white type on periwinkle; label type in #4A4E7C inside butter-yellow #F2D488 pill capsules; identical hierarchy, sizes and corner radii on every screen; all Chinese copy supplied as placeholders
